name: io.github.DasRed/discord-mcp
title: Discord
description: Read Discord servers, channels and direct messages of your account, optionally send messages.

runtimeArguments.name: -p
runtimeArguments.description: Port mapping host:container. The URL below assumes host port 3000.

runtimeArguments.name: -v
runtimeArguments.description: Volume for the stored Discord session, otherwise every start needs a new login

runtimeArguments.name: --shm-size
runtimeArguments.description: Shared memory for Chromium during the login

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: "Bearer <token>", only needed when DISCORD_MCP_AUTH_TOKEN is set

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MCP_DISCORD_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Email of the Discord account, not needed with DISCORD_MCP_DISCORD_TOKEN

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MCP_DISCORD_TOTP_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Base32 secret of the authenticator app for two-factor authentication

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MCP_DISCORD_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Session token, skips the browser login

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Only expose read-only tools, false adds send_message

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MCP_AUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: If set, the MCP endpoint requires Authorization: Bearer <token>
